title.zh: NYSE , Blockchain . com explore tokenised versions of US - listed stocks
title.en: NYSE , Blockchain . com explore tokenised versions of US - listed stocks

current_state.zh: NYSE 与 Blockchain.com 已签署谅解备忘录，探索在 NYSE 计划中的 24/7 代币化证券平台上向加密原生用户提供美股和 ETF 接入，并建立双向市场数据合作；尚待监管批准，上线时间、合格市场和可用证券未定。
current_state.en: NYSE and Blockchain.com have signed a memorandum of understanding to explore giving crypto-native users access to US-listed stocks and ETFs on NYSE's planned 24/7 tokenized securities venue, with a two-way market-data arrangement; regulatory approval, launch timing, eligible markets and available securities remain unresolved.

updates.title_zh: NYSE is assembling the pipes for a $5.5 trillion tokenized asset market
updates.title_en: NYSE is assembling the pipes for a $5.5 trillion tokenized asset market
updates.what_changed_zh: NYSE Group 与 Blockchain.com 签署谅解备忘录，拟让 Blockchain.com 用户接入 NYSE 计划中的 24/7 代币化证券交易场所，交易美股和 ETF，并建立覆盖股票与加密资产的双向市场数据合作；仍需监管批准。
updates.what_changed_en: NYSE Group and Blockchain.com signed a memorandum of understanding to explore giving Blockchain.com users access to US-listed stocks and ETFs on NYSE's planned 24/7 tokenized securities venue, alongside a two-way market-data arrangement covering stocks and crypto, subject to regulatory approval.
